body.p: Claims 1-20 were originally filed in the present application. In the present response, claims 10-20 have been canceled, without prejudice or disclaimer. Also, new claims 21-29 are added. No claims have been amended, and no new matter has been added by the present amendments. Accordingly, claims 1-9 and 21-29 are now pending in the present application, and Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the present application in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks. II. RESTRICTION REQUIREMENT
The Office Action has issued a Restriction Requirement of Claims 1-20 as allegedly reciting three distinct inventions, as follows:
Group II: Claims 10-17 Group III: Claims 18-20

In response, Applicant has canceled claims 10-20 (Groups II & III), without prejudice or disclaimer and pending the filing of one or more Divisional Applications. In addition, Applicant has added new claims 21-29, which are method claims having elements corresponding to the elements of system claims 1-9. Thus, it is believed that new claims 21-29 should be entered in the pending application, or, alternatively, if it is asserted that claims 21-29 should be withdrawn, that these claims be rejoined once their corresponding claims 1-9 are deemed allowable. III. NO WAIVER

All of Applicant's arguments and amendments are without prejudice or disclaimer. Additionally, Applicant has merely discussed example distinctions from the cited references. Other distinctions may exist, and Applicant reserves the right to discuss these additional distinctions in a later Response or on Appeal, if appropriate. By not responding to any additional statements made by the Examiner, Applicant does not acquiesce to an such additional statements, such as, for example, any statements relating to what would be obvious to a person of ordinary skill in the art. Moreover, in the course of the foregoing discussions, applicant may have at times referred to claim limitations in shorthand fashion, or may have focused on a particular claim element. These discussions should not be interpreted to mean that the other limitations can be
ignored or dismissed. The claims must be viewed as a whole, and each limitation of the claims must be considered when determining the patentability of the claims.

In light of the above amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the outstanding rejections. Applicant further submits that the application is now in condition for allowance, and earnestly solicits timely notice of the same. Should the Examiner have any questions, comments or suggestions in furtherance of the prosecution of this application, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney by telephone, facsimile, or electronic mail.

Applicant notes that the two-month deadline for filing a response to the Office Action expires October 16, 2024. Thus, this response is timely and no Extension of Time is believed to be due with the present filing.

Applicant adds new claims 21-29 in the present response, but also cancels originally filed claims 10-20, thereby leaving a total of 18 total claims, including just two independent claims, pending in the present application. Accordingly, no excess claims fees are believed to be due with the present response.

If it is determined that an Extension of Time is required, such extension is hereby requested. Although no fees are believed to be due with the present response, if any fees are found to be due, the Commissioner is authorized to charge any such fees, or credit any overpayment, to Carstens, Allen & Gourley, LLP, Deposit Account No. 50-0392, referencing the Attorney Docket number specified herein.
